steps.clue: Stand on the four elevator symbols at the same time.
Activate the four floor symbols in the correct order.
Shoot the two orbs from the dragons’ mouths with a sniper rifle.
Kill zombies in the Buddha Room, then fire the upgraded Ballistic Knife inside.
Align four Trample Steams on the lion symbols and bounce both orbs across the rooftops.
Punch the tower columns with Galvaknuckles in the order shown by the Mahjong tiles.
